purpose: Read-mostly SA/Dev/Tech intelligence surface over Project Kernel snapshots, not a transactional runtime dependency.

serving_policy.default: Serve the latest completed snapshot immediately.
serving_policy.stale_behavior: Show snapshot SHA/time and stale scopes; offer explicit refresh without blocking page rendering.
serving_policy.refresh: Use background/single-flight rebuild and sparse status updates only while building.
serving_policy.idle: No polling and no source scan when nobody is viewing or requesting refresh.
serving_policy.history: Accepted-SHA snapshots are immutable analytical evidence and support time-travel/diff views.

production_safety.business_queue_priority: development intelligence must never outrank product-critical queues
production_safety.failure_behavior: Keep serving the last successful snapshot with visible failed/stale status.
